errors.evidence: The description of the x-axis states it has 'integer increments' but fails to specify the actual tick label interval of 2, as requested by the prompt for regularly spaced numeric ticks.
The description incorrectly identifies the symbol in the y-axis label as a left arrow '(←)' when the figure clearly shows a down arrow '(↓)'.
The starting value for the 'Random' method at 0 examples is stated to be 'about 17.8', but the data point in the figure is visibly higher, at approximately 17.9.
